metadata.scenario_context: A group of international software firms are partnering on a development venture and have agreed to schedule a coordination meeting in mid-September to evaluate their progress so far.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Chile agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the September 15.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is good to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Levi
shared_prefix.message: I don’t really see meaningful differences here. People have their own views on governance, but live and let live, right? It's just a part of how the world works. At the end of the day, it's all the same. Let’s focus on the meeting—proposing September 15 sounds good, and as long as we're speaking the same language, people figure it out. We can check with everyone else to make sure it works.
